items: 【Baker's Rack with Power Outlet】This kitchen bakers rack comes with a power outlet to charge electronic kitchen appliances such as microwaves, coffee makers or toasters without having to move them. The kitchen storage rack is super handy, and the rustic brown finish adds a nice touch to the space.

【Ample Storage Space】The top of this kitchen microwave stand can store spices, oils, sugar and hang a few cups with S hooks. The spacious tabletop can accommodate kitchen appliances such as a microwave, coffee maker, rice cooker or deep fryer. This kitchen microwave rack has four open mesh shelves that provide ample storage space. Meanwhile, you can choose shelves of different heights depending on the items you need to place. The height of the right shelf can also be adjusted as needed.

【Sturdy Construction】This sturdy kitchen bakers rack with storage is made from durable wood board and a strong metal frame, so kitchen appliances and crockery will find a stable place to stay. It also comes with four adjustable feet for added stability, ensuring the baker's rack is stable and solid even on uneven surfaces.

【Simple Microwave Stand with 10 S Hooks】The additional 10 S-shaped hooks on this microwave stand with power outlet provide more storage space for small kitchen utensils. Not only do they allow you to hang cups, spoons and insulated gloves in an organised way, but you can also place the hooks on the side to hang your pans.

【Easy to Assemble】The coffee bar with power outlet can be assembled without the need for additional tools. It comes with detailed instructions, numbered parts, and an assembly tool to ensure a quick and efficient assembly process, which saves space and time.
